trade.name: Makes money if Nifty stays above 25,700 till Tuesday 1 Dec
legs: SELL 1 lot  Nifty 1-Dec  25,700 PE  at about ₹131
BUY  1 lot  Nifty 1-Dec  25,500 PE  at about ₹79
trade.maxLoss: The most you can lose: ₹9,620 (148 points × 65)
trade.when: Only after Nifty dips to 25,800–25,850 today and a full 15-minute candle closes above 25,800; if it never dips, no trade.
trade.exit: Close both legs if a 15-minute candle closes below 25,760, or once you have kept half of the ₹3,380.

why: Today big traders have placed 735,000 new bets that Nifty won't fall, three times the bets that it won't rise; the jump is being backed, not faded.
The biggest bet on the board, 123,000 contracts, says Nifty won't fall below 25,700; that is the level the trade leans on, 216 points below today's price.
The biggest bet that it won't rise sits at 26,000, just 84 points above, so a rally usually pauses there; don't buy above it.
The trade sells a promise that Nifty stays above 25,700 and buys a cheaper promise below it as insurance, so the loss is capped whatever happens.
simple.risk: Trade one lot only. ₹9,620 is the most you can lose, nearly three times the ₹3,380 you collect, so honour the 25,760 stop. A 567-point day can give back 200 by the close. Paper-trade two weeks before real money.
glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Nifty options trade in lots of 65 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹65 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
Iron condor
A call spread and a put spread sold together. You collect both premiums; it pays if Nifty stays between the two sold strikes, and the loss is capped.
